hypothesis: The Kova free-data sidecar should run inside the daily production pipeline as a cheap default-off data refresh so forward rows accumulate without affecting strategy decisions.

efficiency_controls.ohlcv_source: production in-memory ohlcv_dict plus SPY when available
efficiency_controls.companyfacts_default: read local selected Companyfacts rows inside an 820-day filed-date lookback, skip non-overlapping file ranges, and dedupe overlapping files

env_gates.KOVA_REFRESH_INTRADAY: set to 1 to fetch Alpha Vantage intraday rows
env_gates.KOVA_REFRESH_COMPANYFACTS: set to 1 to refresh Companyfacts inputs
env_gates.KOVA_COMPANYFACTS_LOOKBACK_DAYS: optional local Companyfacts filed-date read window, default 820
env_gates.KOVA_REFRESH_SEC13F: set to 1 to download SEC 13F dataset zip

gate1.baseline_protocol: measurement repair; no strategy before/after expected_value_score change

gate2.missing_field_behavior: write skipped or unavailable rows; do not fail production

gate4.acceptance_rule: Production run writes Kova sidecar snapshot cheaply from in-memory OHLCV/local files by default; network sources remain explicit env-gated; no strategy path consumes the fields.

verification.full_production_run_note: Not run during closeout because quant/run.py can invoke live data/news/LLM paths; the production sidecar call is covered by direct unit tests and py_compile.

next_retry_requires: A later alpha_search ticket if any Kova field is consumed by VCP gating, ranking, sizing, exits, or live orders.
Forward rows with closed outcomes before promoting intraday, fundamental, RS proxy, or institutional surfaces.
